Name: Confirm Gifts
Author: BadScientist89
Description:
Have you ever had an NPC walk out of a door at the same time you right click to go in so they steal your held item... and then get mad at you because they didn't like it?
Have you ever tried to eat food while fishing without noticing an NPC had walked up and stood right on top of you so they steal your food... and then get mad at you because they didn't like it?
Have you ever bought an item from an NPC and then immediately tried to use it without walking away from them first so they steal the thing you just bought from them... and then get mad at you because they didn't like it?

Well no more!

This mod adds a simple confirmation dialogue to make sure you [i]really[/i] want to give that item to an NPC before taking it from you. It can also show how much the NPC will like the gift (can be toggled on or off with Generic Mod Config Menu). The confirmation box will [i]not[/i] appear when turning in an item for a quest.
